hooks.name: H3 Re-run the app data contract test
hooks.description: The app reads fixed key names out of app/public/data/*.json and computes nothing itself. Renaming a field in an analysis script without renaming it in the builder produces a blank panel rather than an error, which is the failure mode most likely to survive to submission. Any edit under analysis/scripts re-runs the contract test, which checks that every payload still has the keys its component reads.
